concept.title: Git Client Add-on
concept.shortdesc: The Git Client add-on brings a full Git client into , so you can commit, push, pull, branch, and resolve conflicts without leaving the editor.

conbody.note: This add-on is compatible with Oxygen XML Editor, Oxygen XML Author, Oxygen XML Developer, and Oxygen JSON Editor.
conbody.p: After you install it, the Git Client adds three dedicated views, a top-level menu, a preferences page, and contextual Git actions in other views and editors:

ul.li: The view is where you review changes, stage them, commit, push, and pull.
The view shows the commit graph and lets you inspect and compare revisions.
The view lists your local and remote branches.

conbody.p: The topics that follow are arranged in the order you'll usually need them: install the add-on, get oriented, connect to a server, and set up a repository; then review and commit your work, synchronize with the remote, resolve conflicts, work with branches and tags, and review history. Advanced workflows, configuration, a full interface and actions reference, and troubleshooting come at the end for lookup.
